records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Charter revenues were $2.9 million higher in the Current Year Quarter compared with the Prior Year Quarter.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Oil prices were as high as $76 per barrel in October 2018 and, during the beginning of COVID-19 pandemic in the U.S. and elsewhere throughout the globe, WTI front month oil prices were pushed for a short period of time to a new low of -$37.63 per barrel in April 2020 before recovering to $48 per barrel by year end.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Charter revenues were $3.9 million higher due to higher utilization of the core fleet.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Prices deteriorated beginning in the second half of 2014 and continued to deteriorate when oil prices hit a thirteen-year low of less than $27 per barrel (on the New York Mercantile Exchange) in February 2016.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Cash flows provided by continuing operating activities increased by $32.3 million in the Current Nine Months compared with the Prior Nine Months.
